summary.scope: Actual packaged Linux portrait app, graphics request vulkan, temporary profile, periodic local synthetic PCM through real playback/model, recorded source resampled into 1280x720 canvas at requested 30 Hz with actual local tracking/AR and DOM/native wardrobe ingestion; sleep deadline accelerated to 1.5 seconds during its dedicated phase; no physical camera/microphone/cloud/Internet media; CPU is live process-tree work, RSS is summed and may double-count shared pages; GPU metrics cover the whole device, not only this app.
